title: THE RACKS PAGE LINES UP
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08, on the 4K RACKS screenshot. The sentence at the top of the page started at its left edge, the row of ten rack boxes and the BUILD A RACK, FOLD and SLOT buttons started a step to the right of it, and the small lines under each button a second step further in, so the page looked like three ragged columns. Everything on the page now starts on the same left edge.
now: The RACKS page at the Mainframe now lines up on one left edge.
